title: New Year Resolutions
question: What marked the end of the writer's New Year resolutions?

meanings.usage: 指新年的决心或决定，常用make a resolution
由mental加-ly构成，修饰动词或形容词
形容令人印象深刻或感到畏惧的事物
形容缺乏变化、重复的事物
指达到目标或获得成就
形容长期形成的难以改变的习惯
指未能实现目标的失望感
形容有强烈愿望和目标的
形容认真不懈地做某事
指出卖或泄露秘密，也可指暴露内心感受
指用言语嘲笑或羞辱他人
指兴趣、力量等逐渐减少
指导致失败或毁灭的事物
指控制自己行为的能力

examples.en: The same old favourites recur year in year out with monotonous regularity.
examples.zh: 同样的喜好年复一年地以单调的规律性重复出现。

examples.en: Do a thousand and one jobs about the house.
examples.zh: 做无数的家务事。

examples.en: We never have time to carry them out.
examples.zh: 我们从没有时间去实现它们。

examples.en: When we slip back into our bad old ways.
examples.zh: 当我们重新回到坏习惯时。

examples.en: I applied myself assiduously to the task.
examples.zh: 我勤奋地致力于这项任务。

phrases.usage: 悄悄溜下；蹑手蹑脚地走下

examples.en: I managed to creep down into the living room.
examples.zh: 我设法悄悄溜进客厅。

examples.en: I fended off the taunts and jibes of the family.
examples.zh: 我挡开了家人的嘲笑和讽刺。

examples.en: Little by little the eleven minutes fell to zero.
examples.zh: 渐渐地，十一分钟降到了零。

examples.en: I soon got back to my old bad habit of dozing off in front of the screen.
examples.zh: 我很快又回到了在屏幕前打瞌睡的坏习惯。

phrases.usage: 对某事保密；不告诉别人

examples.en: This year I attempted to keep my resolutions to myself.
examples.zh: 今年我试图对自己的决心保密。

sentences.en: The New Year is a time for resolutions.
sentences.zh: 新年是制定决心的时候。

sentences.en: Mentally, at least, most of us could compile formidable lists of 'dos' and 'don'ts'.
sentences.zh: 至少在心理上，我们大多数人都能列出一长串“该做”和“不该做”的事情。

sentences.en: The same old favourites recur year in year out with monotonous regularity.
sentences.zh: 那些老掉牙的旧习惯年复一年地以单调的规律重现。

sentences.en: We resolve to get up earlier each morning, eat less,
sentences.zh: 我们下决心每天早起，少吃，

sentences.en: find more time to play with the children, do a thousand and one jobs about the house,
sentences.zh: 抽出更多时间陪孩子们玩，做成千上万件家务，

sentences.en: be nice to people we don't like, drive carefully, and take the dog for a walk every day.
sentences.zh: 对不喜欢的人和善，小心驾驶，以及每天遛狗。

sentences.en: Past experience has taught us that certain accomplishments are beyond attainment.
sentences.zh: 过去的经验告诉我们，有些成就是无法实现的。

sentences.en: If we remain inveterate smokers, it is only because we have so often experienced the frustration that results from failure.
sentences.zh: 如果我们仍是老烟枪，那只是因为我们屡次体验了失败带来的挫折感。

sentences.en: Most of us fail in our efforts at self-improvement because our schemes are too ambitious and we never have time to carry them out.
sentences.zh: 我们大多数人在自我改进方面都失败了，因为我们的计划过于雄心勃勃，我们根本没有时间去实施。

sentences.en: We also make the fundamental error of announcing our resolutions to everybody
sentences.zh: 我们还犯了一个根本性的错误，那就是向所有人宣布我们的决心，

sentences.en: so that we look even more foolish when we slip back into our bad old ways.
sentences.zh: 这样当我们故态复萌时，就会显得更加愚蠢。

sentences.en: Aware of these pitfalls, this year I attempted to keep my resolutions to myself.
sentences.zh: 意识到这些陷阱，今年我试图把我的决心藏在心里。

sentences.en: I limited myself to two modest ambitions: to do physical exercises every morning and to read more of an evening.
sentences.zh: 我只限制自己两个适度的抱负：每天早上做体育锻炼，晚上多读书。

sentences.en: An all-night party on New Year's Eve provided me with a good excuse for not carrying out either of these new resolutions on the first day of the year,
sentences.zh: 新年前夜的通宵派对给了我一个很好的借口，让我在新年第一天没有执行这两项新决心，

sentences.en: but on the second, I applied myself assiduously to the task.
sentences.zh: 但在第二天，我勤奋地投入到这项任务中。

sentences.en: The daily exercises lasted only eleven minutes and I proposed to do them early in the morning before anyone had got up.
sentences.zh: 每天的锻炼只持续11分钟，我打算在大家起床之前一大早做。

sentences.en: The self-discipline required to drag myself out of bed 11 minutes earlier than usual was considerable.
sentences.zh: 要比平时早11分钟把自己从床上拽起来，需要的自律性是相当大的。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, I managed to creep down into the living room for two days before anyone found me out.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，我还是设法偷偷溜到客厅里去了两天，才被人发现。

sentences.en: After jumping about on the carpet and twisting the human frame into uncomfortable positions,
sentences.zh: 在地毯上跳来跳去，把身体扭曲成不舒服的姿势之后，

sentences.en: I sat down at the breakfast table in an exhausted condition.
sentences.zh: 我筋疲力尽地坐到早餐桌旁。

sentences.en: It was this that betrayed me.
sentences.zh: 就是这个把我出卖了。

sentences.en: The next morning the whole family trooped in to watch the performance.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，全家人都跑进来观看表演。

sentences.en: That was really unsettling but I fended off the taunts and jibes of the family good-humouredly and soon everybody got used to the idea.
sentences.zh: 这确实让人不安，但我还是好脾气地抵挡住了家人的嘲讽和揶揄，很快大家就习惯了。

sentences.en: However, my enthusiasm waned.
sentences.zh: 然而，我的热情消退了。

sentences.en: The time I spent at exercises gradually diminished.
sentences.zh: 我花在锻炼上的时间逐渐减少。

sentences.en: Little by little the eleven minutes fell to zero.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，那11分钟变成了零。

sentences.en: By January 10th, I was back to where I had started from.
sentences.zh: 到了1月10日，我又回到了起点。

sentences.en: I argued that if I spent less time exhausting myself at exercises in the morning,
sentences.zh: 我辩解说，如果早上少花点时间在锻炼上把自己搞得精疲力尽，

sentences.en: I would keep my mind fresh for reading when I got home from work.
sentences.zh: 那么我下班回家时，头脑会更清醒，可以用来阅读。

sentences.en: Resisting the hypnotizing effect of television,
sentences.zh: 抵制住电视的催眠作用，

sentences.en: I sat in my room for a few evenings with my eyes glued to a book.
sentences.zh: 有几个晚上，我坐在房间里，眼睛紧盯着一本书。

sentences.en: One night, however, feeling cold and lonely, I went downstairs and sat in front of the television pretending to read.
sentences.zh: 然而，有一天晚上，我感到又冷又寂寞，于是下楼坐在电视机前假装看书。

sentences.en: That proved to be my undoing, for I soon got back to my old bad habit of dozing off in front of the screen.
sentences.zh: 那被证明是我的失败，因为我很快又回到了在屏幕前打瞌睡的旧习惯。

sentences.en: I still haven't given up my resolution to do more reading.
sentences.zh: 我还没有放弃多读书的决心。

sentences.en: In fact, I have just bought a book entitled How to Read a Thousand Words a Minute.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我刚买了一本名为《如何一分钟阅读一千字》的书。

sentences.en: Perhaps it will solve my problem, but I just haven't had time to read it!
sentences.zh: 也许它能解决我的问题，但我就是没时间读它！

exercises.prompt: “达到；成就” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: attainment · /əˈteɪnmənt/ · noun · 达到；成就。指达到目标或获得成就

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：根深蒂固的；积习的
exercises.explain: inveterate · /ɪnˈvetərət/ · adj · 根深蒂固的；积习的。形容长期形成的难以改变的习惯

exercises.prompt: 补全短语：I managed to _____ into the living room.
exercises.explain: creep down：悄悄溜下；蹑手蹑脚地走下（我设法悄悄溜进客厅。）

exercises.prompt: 补全句子：If we remain inveterate smokers, it is only _____ we have so often experienced the frustration that results from failure.
exercises.hint: 如果我们仍是老烟枪，那只是因为我们屡次体验了失败带来的挫折感。
exercises.explain: If we remain inveterate smokers, it is only because we have so often experienced the frustration that results from failure. — 如果我们仍是老烟枪，那只是因为我们屡次体验了失败带来的挫折感。

source.en: If we remain inveterate smokers, it is only because we have so often experienced the frustration that results from failure.

exercises.prompt: “定冠词the用于特指谈话双方都知道的特定事物” 描述的是哪个语法点？
options: Only + 状语 置于句首的倒装
定冠词the的特指用法 (Definite Article 'the' for Specific Reference)
exercises.explain: 定冠词the的特指用法 (Definite Article 'the' for Specific Reference)：the + 名词：当名词被上下文限定、或者谈话双方都知道的事物时使用the

source.title: 定冠词the的特指用法 (Definite Article 'the' for Specific Reference)

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
The daily exercises lasted only eleven minutes and I proposed to do them early in the morning before anyone had got up.
options: 我抬起头，看到我们已经被一群衣衫褴褛的孩子围住了，他们一言不发地看着我们吃东西。
每天的锻炼只持续11分钟，我打算在大家起床之前一大早做。
我们很幸运，只有较低的田地，
如果你要赶火车，最好是提前充足时间，而不是哪怕晚一分钟。
exercises.explain: The daily exercises lasted only eleven minutes and I proposed to do them early in the morning before anyone had got up. — 每天的锻炼只持续11分钟，我打算在大家起床之前一大早做。

source.en: The daily exercises lasted only eleven minutes and I proposed to do them early in the morning before anyone had got up.

grammar.title: 动词不定式作表语 (Infinitive as Predicative)
grammar.definition: 动词不定式可以在句中作表语，说明主语的内容或目标
grammar.structure: 主语 + be + to + 动词原形
grammar.usage: 用于说明计划、意图、命运等，或与resolution, aim, goal等名词搭配

examples.en: My resolution is to read more.
examples.zh: 我的决心是多读书。

examples.en: Our aim is to finish the project on time.
examples.zh: 我们的目标是按时完成项目。

grammar.title: 结果状语从句 (Consecutive Clause)
grammar.definition: 由so...that或such...that引导，表示某种原因导致的结果
grammar.structure: so + adj/adv + that / such + (a/an) + adj + n + that
grammar.usage: 用于描述由于前面情况而产生的自然结果

examples.en: The daily exercises lasted only eleven minutes so that I could finish them quickly.
examples.zh: 每日锻炼只持续了十一分钟，所以我能很快完成。

examples.en: It was such cold weather that nobody wanted to go out.
examples.zh: 天气太冷了，没有人想出去。

grammar.title: 定冠词the的特指用法 (Definite Article 'the' for Specific Reference)
grammar.definition: 定冠词the用于特指谈话双方都知道的特定事物
grammar.usage: 当名词被上下文限定、或者谈话双方都知道的事物时使用the

examples.en: The next morning the whole family trooped in.
examples.zh: 第二天早上，全家人鱼贯而入。

examples.en: The dog is sleeping under the table.
examples.zh: 那只狗正在桌子下面睡觉。

patterns.pattern: We resolve to + 动词原形

original.en: We resolve to get up earlier each morning.
original.zh: 我们决心每天早上早起。

examples.en: I resolve to exercise more this year.
examples.zh: 我决心今年多锻炼。

examples.en: She resolves to learn a new language.
examples.zh: 她决心学习一门新语言。

patterns.pattern: It is/was + this/that + that + 动词

original.en: It was this that betrayed me.

examples.en: It was the cold weather that kept me indoors.
examples.zh: 正是寒冷的天气让我待在室内。

examples.en: It was her kindness that saved the day.
examples.zh: 正是她的善良挽救了局面。

patterns.pattern: Little by little + 主语 + 动词

original.en: Little by little the eleven minutes fell to zero.
original.zh: 渐渐地，十一分钟降到了零。

examples.en: Little by little the snow melted away.
examples.zh: 雪渐渐融化了。

examples.en: Little by little he recovered his confidence.
examples.zh: 他渐渐恢复了信心。

patterns.pattern: Past experience has taught us that + 从句

original.en: Past experience has taught us that certain accomplishments are beyond attainment.
original.zh: 过去的经验告诉我们，某些目标是无法实现的。

examples.en: Life has taught us that patience is a virtue.
examples.zh: 生活教会我们耐心是一种美德。

examples.en: Experience has taught me that honesty pays off.
examples.zh: 经验告诉我诚实是有回报的。
